name: twohelixes
description: Tiny tracking + reporting client for twoHelixes product analytics (browser, Node, Bun)
author: Lee Penkman

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p .
